import torch
import triton
import triton.language as tl


@triton.jit
def _topk_fill_kernel(seq_lens, block_table, out, MAX_NUM_PAGES: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
    pid_t = tl.program_id(0)
    b = tl.program_id(1)

    offs = pid_t * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
    seq_len = tl.load(seq_lens + b)
    actual_topk = tl.minimum(seq_len, 2048)

    valid = offs < actual_topk
    page_pos = offs >> 6
    token_off = offs & 63

    pages = tl.load(
        block_table + b * MAX_NUM_PAGES + page_pos,
        mask=valid & (page_pos < MAX_NUM_PAGES),
        other=0,
    )

    vals = pages * 64 + token_off
    vals = tl.where(valid, vals, -1)

    tl.store(out + b * 2048 + offs, vals, mask=offs < 2048)


def kernel_function(q_index_fp8, k_index_cache_fp8, weights, seq_lens, block_table):
    batch_size = q_index_fp8.shape[0]
    out = torch.empty((batch_size, 2048), device=q_index_fp8.device, dtype=torch.int32)

    grid = (triton.cdiv(2048, 64), batch_size)
    _topk_fill_kernel[grid](
        seq_lens,
        block_table,
        out,
        MAX_NUM_PAGES=block_table.shape[1],
        BLOCK=64,
        num_warps=2,
    )

    return (out,)
